name: Project Setup
description: One-time bootstrap: detect stack, fill config, test users; generate EXECUTION-GUIDE.md, INDEX.md, DATABASE-TABLES.md.

name: Project Analysis
description: Auto-detect host project: stack, routes, auth, DB, package managers (used by setup).

name: Write Test Cases
description: Prompt 2 — story file to Markdown test cases, one file per screen, with gaps, conventions, test data, Playwright notes.

name: Execute Tests
description: Prompt 1 — run every case of one test-case file with Playwright MCP (browser visible by default); results, screenshots, bug files.
inputs: file: test-case file; headless: optional; summary: optional

name: Fix Bug
description: Prompt 3 — reproduce one bug, smallest fix, verify, update bug file + index, commit.
outputs: bug file Status + Fix Notes, git commit
